Author: OpenCodexMicro
Name: Codex Micro
Overview: Control Codex Desktop tasks and actions from Ulanzi D200 Series in Ulanzi Studio.
Description:
Turn Ulanzi D200 Series into a dedicated Codex Desktop control surface through Ulanzi Studio.

FEATURES
- View five recent Codex tasks with live status and open the exact selected task.
- Show pending approvals and replies on task keys. Use Model & Reasoning Encoder to change the active composer's model or reasoning effort without wrapping.
- Use Fast, Usage, Pin, New, Fork, Steer, Mic, and Submit actions.
- Use the Latest Task & Scroll Encoder action to open task 1 and scroll Codex.
- Install, repair, launch, and check Codex Bridge from every Action setup page.
- Keep communication local through Codex Bridge.app and loopback-only endpoints.
- Context Navigator: First turn opens the + / @ context menu. Turn left to move up and right to move down. Click and release to select; hold and turn either way to close. Clicking or holding and turning while the menu is closed does nothing.
- Launch Codex Bridge: Press one key to launch Codex Bridge.app. If it is missing or incompletely installed, install/repair it automatically, then launch.

INSTALLATION ENVIRONMENT
- macOS 13 or later
- Codex Desktop
- Ulanzi Studio 3.0.1 or later
- Ulanzi D200 Series connected in Ulanzi Studio
- Node.js 20 or later only for manual repository setup

LLM / AGENT INSTALLATION
In your Agent, enter:
Install the Ulanzi Studio plugin for me: https://github.com/UlanziTechnology/OpenCodexMicro#1-llm--agent-installation

MANUAL INSTALLATION
1. Clone https://github.com/UlanziTechnology/OpenCodexMicro and open the repository directory.
2. Quit Ulanzi Studio.
3. Run: npm install
4. Run: npm run install:plugin
5. Run: npm run setup
6. Reopen Ulanzi Studio, quit Codex Desktop, and launch ~/Applications/Codex Bridge.app.
7. Add the Codex Micro actions to your keys in Ulanzi Studio.
8. Select any Action to check Bridge installation, service, and CDP status.

IMPORTANT
When using Codex Micro, always launch Codex through ~/Applications/Codex Bridge.app. Do not open Codex Desktop directly.
Launch command: open ~/Applications/Codex\ Bridge.app
